description: Lists the reviews people left on the app in Neblla's public gallery, each with its id, rating 1-5, text and the developer's reply, plus average, count and distribution of all. Reviews of community entries are in neblla_get_community_entry.

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

limit.description: Most reviews, up to 500 (default 100); the totals cover all.

name: neblla_list_reviews
title: List gallery reviews
